title: Ukraine’s allies convene in Kyiv as Zelenskyy seeks air defence boost
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is meeting with key European allies in Kyiv to urgently request more air defense systems to counter Russia's ongoing missile and drone attacks. This diplomatic summit coincides with Ukraine's Independence Day and follows significant support pledges from Nordic and Baltic nations. As both countries intensify their long-range strikes, the Ukrainian leadership is focused on securing additional interceptor missiles to protect its citizens and infrastructure.

title: Pakistan’s army chief Munir returns to Iran: Can he break US war deadlock?
english: Pakistan's Army Chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, is traveling to Tehran for his third visit this year to discuss regional stability and potential mediation in the ongoing conflict between Iran and the U.S. While Pakistan hopes to act as a bridge to resolve the current diplomatic stalemate, experts remain divided regarding the extent of Islamabad's influence over the warring parties. This mission comes as previous peace talks have largely stalled and new international sanctions against Iran appear likely.

title: Salah scores two goals, has two disallowed in first start for Trabzonspor
english: Mohamed Salah made a strong impact in his first league start for Trabzonspor, scoring both goals in a 2-1 victory over Istanbul Basaksehir. Although he successfully found the net twice, two other potential goals were canceled by the officials. The veteran forward is now preparing for his team's upcoming Europa League match following this successful league performance.

title: Gauff, Fils win Cincinnati tennis titles in run-up to US Open
english: Coco Gauff secured her second Cincinnati Open title by defeating Jessica Pegula in a historic all-American women's final. Meanwhile, Frenchman Arthur Fils claimed his first Masters 1000 victory by beating Frances Tiafoe, marking the first time two Black players faced off in an ATP Masters 1000 championship match. Both athletes are now shifting their focus to the upcoming US Open in New York.

title: Report: Israel used 30 years’ worth of ammunition in less than three years of war
english: A recent report indicates that Israel has consumed three decades' worth of military ammunition in less than three years of conflict. This intense usage has placed a significant strain on the country's financial and material resources. Beyond the logistical impact, the ongoing war has caused severe physical and mental exhaustion among military personnel, raising concerns about the long-term sustainability of the army.

title: Morning update
english: Iraq has proposed a joint security council between Iran and Saudi Arabia to address ongoing regional mistrust. Additionally, regional tensions continue as Israeli forces conducted raids in Syria and diplomatic talks involving Iran and Oman are scheduled.

title: Iraq calls for joint security council between Saudi Arabia and Iran
english: Iraq has officially proposed the establishment of a collaborative security council involving both Saudi Arabia and Iran. A top Iraqi security official explained that this initiative aims to address the significant lack of confidence between the two regional rivals. Baghdad has already shared this formal suggestion with the leadership in both Tehran and Riyadh.

title: Oman foreign minister set to visit Tehran amid ongoing talks over Hormuz Strait
english: Oman's Foreign Minister, Sayyid Badr Albusaidi, is scheduled to visit Tehran this Tuesday for high-level diplomatic discussions. The visit aims to deepen the bilateral partnership between the two nations and support ongoing efforts to maintain security in the Strait of Hormuz. Both countries intend to coordinate their political strategies to promote greater stability throughout the region.
amharic: የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሰይድ ባድር አልቡሳይዲ በሁለትዮሽ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ለማድረግ ማክሰኞ ወደ ቴህራን ያመራሉ። ይህ ጉብኝት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር እና በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ ሰላምንና ደህንነትን ለማስፈን ያለመ ነው። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በክልሉ መረጋጋትን ለመፍጠር በፖለቲካዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ በጋራ ለመስራት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Omaan Sayyid Badr Albusaidi, marii dippilomaasii gaggeessuuf guyyaa Kibxata gara Teheran imaluuf karoorfataniiru. Imalli kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuu fi nageenya Galaana Hormuz irratti mari'achuuf kan gargaaruudha. Biyyonni lamaanuu nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf qindoominaan hojjechuuf fedhii qabu.

title: Senior in Iran's Basij says US was 'forced' to ask for ceasefire
english: Hossein Taeb, a senior leader of Iran’s Basij force, claims that the United States requested a ceasefire because they were forced to negotiate, rather than Iran seeking one. He asserted that Iran stood strong against US pressure and exposed American military vulnerabilities despite the U.S. expecting a swift victory. Additionally, Taeb accused the U.S. of failing to honor previous diplomatic agreements within a short period.
amharic: የኢራን ባሲጅ ሃይል ከፍተኛ አመራር የሆኑት ሆሴን ታኤብ፣ ኢራን የተኩስ አቁም አልጠየቀችም ይልቁንም አሜሪካ በግዴታ ለድርድር መጠየቋን ገልጸዋል። የኢራን ወታደራዊ ሃይል የአሜሪካን ጫና በመቋቋም የአገሪቱን ወታደራዊ ድክመቶች ማጋለጡን ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ አሜሪካ ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ የድርድር ስምምነቶችን በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ መጣሷን ከሰዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoon humna Basij kan Iraan, Hossein Taeb, Ameerikaan ofii ishee dirqamtee marii fi walii galtee akka gaafatte malee, Iraan furmaata nagaa akka hin gaafanne dubbataniiru. Iraan dhiibbaa Ameerikaa jala akka hin jilbeenfanne fi dadhabina waraana Ameerikaa saaxiluu ishee ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Ameerikaan kanaan dura walii galtee irra ga'ame guyyoota muraasa keessatti cabsuu ishee himataniiru.

title: Minority Protection is Ethiopia’s Federal Test
english: Ethiopia must strengthen its constitutional safeguards to ensure that smaller ethnic groups are not dominated by larger ones within its federal system. The author suggests creating formal protections, such as equal representation in government and veto powers for smaller regions, to prevent majority rule. Additionally, the country needs to address historical grievances and adopt inclusive national symbols to foster genuine unity and trust across all communities.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ በፌዴራል ስርዓቷ ውስጥ ትናንሽ ብሄረሰቦች በትልልቅ ቡድኖች እንዳይጨቆኑ የህገ መንግስት ጥበቃዋን ማጠናከር አለባት። የጽሁፉ ደራሲ የመንግስት ውክልናን እኩል በማድረግ እና ለትናንሽ ክልሎች የቪቶ መብት በመስጠት አብላጫ ድምፅ የበላይነትን መከላከል እንደሚገባ ያሳስባሉ። ከዚህም በላይ ሀገሪቱ ታሪካዊ ቅሬታዎችን በመፍታት እና ሁሉንም ማህበረሰቦች የሚያቅፉ ብሄራዊ ምልክቶችን በመጠቀም እውነተኛ አንድነት መገንባት አለባት።
oromo: Itoophiyaan sirna federaalizimii ishee keessatti sanyiiwwan xixiqqoon garee gurguddaan akka hin hacuucamneef eegumsa seera buuraa cimsuu qabdi. Barreessaan kun akka jedhutti, giddugaleessa mootummaa keessatti bakka bu'iinsa walqixaa uumuu fi naannolee xixiqqoof mirga 'veto' kennuun walitti bu'iinsa baay'een muraa irratti hundaa'u hambisuu danda'a. Kana malees, biyyattiin miidhaa darbe furuudhaan fi mallattoolee biyyaalessaa kanneen ummata hunda hammatan fayyadamuudhaan tokkummaa dhugaa cimsuu qabdi.

title: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
english: Chinese authorities are investigating reports that some cabbage suppliers are illegally using formaldehyde to keep their vegetables fresh during transport. This chemical is prohibited in food production because of its known links to cancer, leading officials to perform market inspections to ensure consumer safety. Police are taking legal action against those involved, and the government is working to reassure the public while assessing the scale of this dangerous practice.
amharic: የቻይና ባለስልጣናት የጎመን አቅራቢዎች አትክልቶቹን ለማቆየት በህገወጥ መንገድ ፎርማልዲሀይድ የተባለ ኬሚካል እየተጠቀሙ መሆኑን በመስማታቸው ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ኬሚካል ካንሰርን ሊያስከትል የሚችል በመሆኑ በምግብ ውስጥ መጠቀም በጥብቅ የተከለከለ ነው። መንግስት ህገወጦችን በህግ ተጠያቂ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅና ስጋትን ለመቀነስ በተለያዩ ገበያዎች ላይ ፍተሻዎችን እያከናወነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Chaayinaa dhiyeessitoonni gubbee (cabbage) gabaaf dhiyaatu haala gaariin akka turuuf jecha suuqiiwwan keessatti 'formaldehyde' jedhamu fayyadamaa akka jiran qorachaa jiru. Kemiikalli kun dhukkuba kaansarii waan fiduuf nyaata keessatti itti fayyadamuu akka hin qabne seeraan dhorkameera. Mootummaan namoota yakka kana raawwatan irratti tarkaanfii seeraa kan fudhachaa jiru yoo ta'u, nageenya ummataa mirkaneessuuf jecha gabaa gara garaa irratti qorannoo cimaa geggeessaa jira.

title: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
english: A recent BBC report provides a rare look at how the Taliban governs Afghanistan, highlighting the severe restrictions placed on women. In one incident, a governor dismissed an 18-year-old woman's request for divorce from her abusive husband by labeling women as inferior. Five years after taking power, the Taliban continues to enforce strict religious laws that exclude women from public life, education, and employment.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ዘገባ ታሊባን አፍጋኒስታንን እንዴት እንደሚያስተዳድርና በሴቶች ላይ የሚጥሉትን ከባድ ገደቦች በግልጽ ያሳያል። አንድ የክልል አስተዳዳሪ ከአስር ስምንት ዓመት ወጣት ሴት የቀረበላትን የፍቺ ጥያቄ ውድቅ በማድረግ ሴቶች የማሰብ ችሎታቸው ዝቅተኛ ነው የሚል አድሎአዊ አስተያየት ሰጥቷል። ሥልጣን ከያዙ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላም፣ ቡድኑ ሴቶችን ከትምህርት፣ ከሥራና ከማኅበራዊ ሕይወት የሚያገሉ ጥብቅ ሕጎችን መተግበሩን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Gabaasni BBC dhiheenya kana bahe, gareen Taliban afgaanistaan akkamitti akka bulchuufi mirga dubartootarratti dhorkaa cimaa akka kaa'e agarsiisa. Haala kanaan, hogganaan naannichaa tokko dubartii umriinshee waggaa 18 ta'e kan abbaa manaa ishee irraa gargar ba'uu barbaaddeef, dubartoota salphisuun deebii kenneera. Taliban waggaa shaniif aangootti erga turee boodas, dubartoonni barnoota, hojiifi jireenya hawaasummaa irraa akka bahaniif seera cimaa amantii irratti hundaa'e hojiirra oolchuu itti fufeera.

title: Former CIA officer describes Aipac's rise to political power
english: In a recent discussion, former CIA officer John Kiriakou and journalist Tucker Carlson examined the political influence of AIPAC and Israel in Washington. They revisited controversial historical events, including the 1967 attack on the USS Liberty and alleged Israeli involvement in the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. Kiriakou claimed that the U.S. government suppressed evidence regarding these incidents to protect its relationship with Israel.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሲአይኤ ኦፊሰር ጆን ኪሪያኩ እና ጋዜጠኛ ታከር ካርልሰን በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ የ AIPAC እና የእስራኤልን በዋሽንግተን ላይ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ መርምረዋል። በውይይታቸውም እ.ኤ.አ በ1967 በዩኤስኤስ ሊበርቲ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት እና የፕሬዚዳንት ጆን ኤፍ ኬኔዲ ግድያ ውስጥ እስራኤል እጇ አለበት የሚሉ አወዛጋቢ ታሪካዊ ክስተቶችን አንስተዋል። ኪሪያኩ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከእስራኤል ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማስቀጠል ሲባል ስለነዚህ ክስተቶች የተባለውን ማስረጃ እንዳፈነው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan duraanii CIA John Kiriakou fi gaazexeessaan Tucker Carlson marii taasisaniin, dhiibbaa siyaasaa AIPAC fi Israa'el Waashingitan keessatti qaban irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Marii isaanii keessatti, haleellaa doonii USS Liberty irratti bara 1967 raawwatamee fi gahee Israa'el ajjeechaa pirezidaant John F. Kennedy keessatti qabaachuu dandeessu kan ibsan seenaa wal-falchiisoo ta'an kaaseeru. Kiriakou akka jedhetti, mootummaan Ameerikaa hariiroo Israa'el wajjin qabu eeggachuuf jecha odeeffannoo fi ragaalee taatee kanaa dhoksuuf yaaleera.

title: Israeli military advances into a village in Syria's Daraa
english: Israeli military forces have entered the village of Maariya, located in the Daraa region of southern Syria. Reports indicate that the troops were accompanied by various military vehicles during this movement. This development marks a notable escalation in the border area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ ዳራ በሚገኘው የማሪያ መንደር መግባታቸው ተዘግቧል። ወታደሮቹ ወደ ስፍራው የገቡት በተለያዩ ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች የታጀቡ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢ ያለው ውጥረት መጨመሩን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Maariyaa kan naannoo Daaraa kibba Sooriyaatti argamtu seenuu isaanii gabaafameera. Waraanni kun konkolaataalee waraanaatiin deeggaramee gara ganda kanaatti akka socho'e ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun naannoo daangaa sanaatti waraanni kun babal'achuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
english: A group of 21 former international cricket captains has sent a formal request to Pakistan's Prime Minister, urging him to provide adequate medical attention to imprisoned former leader Imran Khan. The group emphasizes that Khan, who is 73, should be allowed access to his own doctors and receive consistent care for his health issues, including a reported loss of vision. They are calling for the government to follow court orders by granting him proper medical evaluations and regular family visits without any unnecessary delays.
amharic: 21 የቀድሞ ዓለም አቀፍ የክሪኬት ቡድን መሪዎች ለፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በጻፉት ደብዳቤ፣ በእስር ላይ ለሚገኙት የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ተገቢው የህክምና አገልግሎት እንዲሰጥ ጠይቀዋል። የቡድኑ አባላት የ73 ዓመቱ ኢምራን ካን የራሳቸው የግል ዶክተሮች እንዲያዩዋቸው እና በተለይም በዓይናቸው ላይ የደረሰውን ችግር ጨምሮ አስፈላጊው ህክምና በአስቸኳይ እንዲደረግላቸው አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም መንግስት የፍርድ ቤቱን ትዕዛዝ በማክበር ምንም አይነት መዘግየት ሳይኖር የቤተሰብ ጉብኝት እንዲፈቀድላቸው ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: gareen kapteinota kirikeetii 21 ta'an kan duraanii, waldaan gara muummee ministira Paakistaan barreessaniin, duraan geggeessituu biyyattii kan ta'an Imran Kaan mana hidhaa keessatti yaala fayyaa gahaa akka argatan gaafataniiru. Gareen kun akka jedhutti, Imran Kaan umuriin isaanii 73 ta'uu isaa fi dhibee ijji isaanii irratti mul'ate dabalatee yaala fayyaa barbaachisu akka argatan, akkasumas ogeeyyota fayyaa isaanii mataa isaanii bira gahuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, mootummaan ajaja mana murtiitiin maatiin isaanii yeroo hundaa akka isaan daawwatan akkasumas yaalli isaan barbaachisu osoo hin harkifatin akka kennamuuf gaafataniiru.

title: Maradona’s ‘Hand of God’ ball from Mexico sells for $3.35m
english: The soccer ball used during the famous 1986 World Cup match between Argentina and England was auctioned for $3.35 million. This ball was involved in two iconic moments: Diego Maradona’s controversial 'Hand of God' goal and his incredible 'Goal of the Century.' Argentina won that historic game, eventually leading them to become the tournament champions.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ1986 በአርጀንቲና እና በእንግሊዝ መካከል በተደረገው ዝነኛ የዓለም ዋንጫ ጨዋታ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው የእግር ኳስ ኳስ በ3.35 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ተሽጧል። ይህ ኳስ ዲያጎ ማራዶና በኳስ በታገዘ ጎል ባስቆጠረበት 'የእግዚአብሔር እጅ' እና በታሪክ ተወዳዳሪ በሌለው 'የክፍለ ዘመኑ ጎል' ወቅት አገልግሎት ላይ ውሏል። አርጀንቲና በዚያ ታሪካዊ ጨዋታ በማሸነፍ በመጨረሻ የዓለም ዋንጫውን ማንሳት ችላለች።
oromo: Kubaan miillaa kan bara 1986 tapha seena-qabeessa waancaa addunyaa kan Arjantiinii fi Ingiliz gidduutti taphatame irratti itti fayyadaman, qarshii miliyoona 3.35n gurgurameera. Kubaan kun yeroo Diyaagoo Maaradoonaan goolii 'Harka Waaqayyoo' jedhamuun beekamu fi 'Goolii Jaarraa' jedhamee waamamu seenaa hojjetetti itti fayyadame dha. Arjantiiniin tapha seena-qabeessa sana injifattee, boodarras waancaa addunyaa sana mo'achuun ishee ni yaadatama.

title: Climbers escape rockfall crossing ‘Death Pass’ on Mont Blanc
english: A group of mountain climbers narrowly survived a dangerous rockfall while navigating the Goûter Couloir, a section of Mont Blanc notoriously called Death Pass. A climber captured the terrifying event on video while he and his partner worked to help other hikers reach safety. Fortunately, everyone involved managed to avoid the falling debris and escape the area unharmed.
amharic: በሞንት ብላንክ ተራራ ላይ የሚገኘውን እና ‘የሞት ማለፊያ’ ተብሎ በሚጠራው ስፍራ ላይ የሚጓዙ ተራራ ወጣቾች ከባድ የድንጋይ መפולቀቅ አጋጥሟቸው በታምር ተረፉ። አንድ ወጣች በቪዲዮ የቀረጸው ይህ ክስተት፣ እሱ እና አጋሩ ሌሎች ተጓዦች ከአደጋው እንዲያመልጡ ሲረዱ የሚያሳይ ነው። እንደ እድል ሆኖ፣ ሁሉም ተሳታፊዎች ከድንጋዮቹ ፍርስራሽ በመትረፍ ደህና መሆናቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Gaara Mont Blanc irratti bakka 'Godaansa Du'aa' jedhamuun beekamu keessa kan turan namoonni gaara bahatan tokko, dhagaan suuta gadi dhangala'uun lubbuun isaanii daangaa irra ga'ee ture. Namni tokko viidiyoodhaan waraabe akka agarsiisutti, inni fi hiriyoonni isaa namoota biroo rakkoo kana keessaa baasuuf gargaarsa godhaniiru. Gamtaan, namoonni hundinuu dhagaa gadi bu'aa ture sana jalaa lubbuun hafan.

title: ‘We know this movie’: Iran mocks latest US sanctions
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has dismissed the latest round of US sanctions as a repetitive and ineffective strategy. He compared the move to watching an old film, suggesting that current American pressure tactics are essentially the same as those used by previous administrations. Araghchi characterized these measures as bullying that fails to change the existing political reality.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ አዲሱን የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ እንደ ተደጋጋሚ እና ውጤት አልባ ድርጊት አጣጥለውታል። ሚኒስትሩ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምትጥለው ማዕቀብ ቀደም ሲል ከነበሩት የአሜሪካ አስተዳደሮች የተለየ አይደለም ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ይህንን ድርጊትም የጉልበት ብልጠት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ምንም አይነት ለውጥ እንደማያመጣ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchii, adabbiiwwan haaraa Ameerikaan irra keette kana akka gocha baramaa fi bu'aa hin qabneetti fudhataniiru. Gocha kana filmii yeroo hedduu mul'atu waliin kan wal-mamsiisan yoo ta'u, dhiibbaan Ameerikaa kun kan bulchiinsa kanaan duraa irraa adda akka hin taane dubbataniiru. Araagchiin adeemsa kana gocha qabeenyi itti mul'atu fi jijjiirama tokkollee fiduu hin dandeenye jedhanii ibsaniiru.

title: Syria, Israel hold US-mediated talks in Jordan to de-escalate tensions
english: Syrian and Israeli officials recently held high-level meetings in Jordan, facilitated by the United States, to reduce rising military tensions. The discussions, which included the head of the Mossad and the Syrian Foreign Minister, aimed to establish security protocols and end ongoing border strikes. Furthermore, the parties addressed the need to prevent the rivalry between Israel and Turkey from destabilizing the Syrian region.
amharic: የሶሪያ እና የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በዮርዳኖስ ተገናኝተው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ ተወያይተዋል። በውይይቱ ላይ የሞሳድ መሪ እና የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር የተሳተፉ ሲሆን፣ ዓላማውም በድንበር አካባቢ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶችን ለማስቆም እና የፀጥታ ስምምነት ለመፍጠር ነው። በተጨማሪም ሁለቱ ወገኖች በእስራኤል እና በቱርክ መካከል ያለው አለመግባባት በሶሪያ ላይ ተጨማሪ ችግር እንዳይፈጥር ለመከላከል ተነጋግረዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Siriyaa fi Israa'eel waldhabdee gidduu isaanii jiru hir'isuuf, fedhii Ameerikaatiin biyya Yoordaanos keessatti wal arganii mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun mataa dhaabbata basaasaa Israa'eel (Mossad) fi ministira dhimmi alaa Siiriyaa kan hirmaachise yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas haleellaa daangaa irratti gaggeeffamu dhaabuufi nageenya mirkaneessuu dha. Kana malees, gamtaan lameen kun waldhabdeen Israa'eelii fi Turkiyee gidduu jiru biyya Siiriyaa keessatti miidhaa akka hin geessisne mari'ataniiru.

title: Burnham to visit Kyiv on first foreign trip and reaffirm UK support for Ukraine
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will travel to Kyiv for his first official international visit to mark Ukraine’s independence day and demonstrate the UK's ongoing commitment to the country. During his trip, he will lead a meeting of the 'coalition of the willing' and accept an award acknowledging Britain's assistance. This visit serves to confirm Britain’s resolve in supporting Ukraine against Russian aggression despite recent threats from Moscow.
amharic: የብሪታንያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የዩክሬንን የነጻነት ቀን ለማክበር እና ለሀገሪቱ ያላቸውን ቀጣይ ድጋፍ ለማረጋገጥ የመጀመሪያ የውጭ ጉብኝታቸውን ወደ ኪየቭ ያደርጋሉ። በጉብኝታቸውም የ'ፈቃደኞች ጥምረት' ስብሰባን የሚመሩ ሲሆን ለዩክሬን የብሪታንያን ድጋፍ የሚያሳይ ሽልማት ይቀበላሉ። ይህ ጉብኝት ከሩሲያ የሚሰነዘሩ ማስፈራሪያዎች ቢኖሩም ብሪታንያ በዩክሬን ላይ ለምትሰጠው ድጋፍ ያላትን ጽናት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Biriiteen Antii Barnhaam guyyaa bilisummaa Yukreen kabajuufi deeggarsa biyyattiin Yukreeniif qabdu mirkaneessuuf imala alaa isaanii isa jalqabaa gara Kiyevitti taasisaniiru. Imala isaaniin, walgahii 'gamtaa fedhii qaban' jedhamu kan hoogganan ta'uufi badhaasa deeggarsa Biriiteen Yukreeniif goote agarsiisu fudhatu. Imalli kun sodaachisa Raashiyaa irraa dhufu cinaatti, Biriiteen yukreen gargaaruurratti qabdu cimsattee akka itti fuftu kan mirkaneessudha.

title: Shein aims for almost $27bn valuation in stock market debut
english: The fast-fashion company Shein is set to launch an initial public offering on the Hong Kong stock exchange, aiming for a valuation of nearly $27 billion. This target is significantly lower than its previous $100 billion valuation from 2022 due to rising costs and declining sales. The company has faced recent financial challenges, including quarterly losses, which were partly triggered by new US import taxes and increased operational expenses.
amharic: ፈጣን የፋሽን ኩባንያ የሆነው ሺኢን በሆንግ ኮንግ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ላይ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አክሲዮኖቹን በመሸጥ ወደ 27 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ የገበያ ዋጋ ለመድረስ አቅዷል። ይህ የታቀደው ዋጋ በ2022 ከነበረው 100 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ጋር ሲነጻጸር በጣም ዝቅተኛ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ኩባንያው የገጠመውን ከፍተኛ ወጪ እና የሽያጭ መቀነስ ያሳያል። ኩባንያው በአሜሪካ የታሪፍ ለውጦች እና ሌሎች ተያያዥ ችግሮች ምክንያት በቅርቡ የሩብ ዓመት ኪሳራ አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni uffata qulqulluu fi saffisaa oomishu Shein, gabaa akkooyyee Hong Kong irratti qooda isaa gurgurachuudhaan gatii tilmaama biiliyoona 27 ga'u argachuuf karoorfateera. Gatiin kun bara 2022 keessa turee fi biiliyoona 100 wajjin yoo madaalamu baay'ee kan gadi bu'e yoo ta'u, kunis baasii dabale fi gabaa irratti hir'ina mudateen kan walqabatedha. Dhaabbatichi gibira alaa ergii Amerikaa fi rakkoolee biroo mudataniin walqabatee, ji'oota darban keessa kasaaraa mudachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Nearly 3 million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
english: China has issued a massive recall for nearly three million Tesla vehicles and millions of other EVs due to safety concerns regarding retractable door handles. Authorities worry these hidden designs make it difficult to open doors during emergencies or power failures, posing a risk to passengers and rescuers. In response, Tesla will provide software updates and safety labels, while China prepares to mandate mechanical door releases for all new vehicles by 2027.
amharic: ቻይና በኤሌክትሪክ ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ የሚገኙ የበር መክፈቻዎች ደህንነት ስጋት በመፍጠራቸው ወደ ሶስት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ የቴስላ መኪኖችን ጨምሮ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሌሎች ተሽከርካሪዎችን አስታውሳለች። እነዚህ በሰውነት ውስጥ ተሰውረው የሚቀመጡ የበር መያዣዎች፣ በድንገተኛ አደጋ ጊዜ ለመክፈት አስቸጋሪ በመሆናቸው ለተሳፋሪዎችና ለነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አደጋ ሊያስከትሉ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል። ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ቴስላ የሶፍትዌር ማሻሻያዎችን እና የማስጠንቀቂያ ምልክቶችን የሚያቀርብ ሲሆን፣ የቻይና መንግስትም ከ2027 ጀምሮ ሁሉም አዳዲስ መኪኖች በእጅ የሚከፈት ሜካኒካዊ ዘዴ እንዲኖራቸው አዟል።
oromo: Chaayinaan konkolaattota Tesla miiliyoona sadii dhiyoo ta'an dabalatee, konkolaattota elektirikii biroo miiliyoonatti lakkaa'aman rakkoo nageenyaa harka-duubee balbala (door handles) irraa kan ka'e akka deebifaman ajajdeetti. Harka-duubee balbala kanneen balaa tasaa ykn yeroo humna elektirikaa dhabamu irraan kan ka'e banuun ulfaataa waan ta'eef, lubbuu namootaatiif sodaachisaa ta'uu isaa mootummaan ibseera. Tesla rakkoo kana furuuf fooyya'insa sooftiweerii fi mallattoo akeekkachiisaa kan kennu yoo ta'u, Chaayinaanis bara 2027 irraa eegalee konkolaattoonni hundi sirna balbala bifa mekaanikaatiin banamu qabaachuu akka qaban labsitetti.

title: Human-caused Nevada wildfire forces 42,000 people to evacuate
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire sparked by human activity near Reno, Nevada, has triggered the evacuation of 42,000 residents, with tens of thousands more remaining on standby. The blaze has caused six injuries and damaged multiple houses in the area. Authorities are currently investigating the exact circumstances surrounding how the fire started.
amharic: በኔቫዳ፣ ሬኖ አቅራቢያ በሰው ሰራሽ ድርጊት የተነሳው ፈጣን የእሳት ቃጠሎ 42,000 ነዋሪዎችን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አስገድዷል፣ ሌሎች በርካታ ሺህ ሰዎችም ዝግጁ እንዲሆኑ ተነግሯቸዋል። እሳቱ ስድስት ሰዎችን አቁስሏል እንዲሁም በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን አውድሟል። ባለስልጣናት የእሳቱን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Reno, Nevada tti ibiddi namtolchee hatattamaan ka'e jiraattota 42,000 ta'an qe'ee isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqisiiseera, namoonni kumni 45 ol ta'anis eeggannoo cimaa keessa jiru. Iddoo kanaatti ibiddi kun namoota ja'a irratti miidhaa geessisee manneen jireenyaas barbadeesseera. Abbootiin taayitaa sababa ibidda kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Can Kenya’s AI ambitions coexist with Naivasha’s water needs?
english: Kenya is planning to host a massive data center near Lake Naivasha backed by Microsoft and G42 to advance its artificial intelligence goals. However, local residents are concerned that this project might worsen existing water shortages that already threaten their livestock and daily survival. While developers promise to use renewable energy and water-saving technology, the community remains anxious about the potential strain on their vital water resources.
amharic: ኬንያ በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፍ ያላትን ዓላማ ለማሳካት በማይክሮሶፍት እና በጂ-42 ድጋፍ ናይቫሻ ሀይቅ አቅራቢያ ትልቅ የዳታ ማዕከል ለመገንባት እቅድ አውጥታለች። ይሁን እንጂ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ይህ ፕሮጀክት ለቤት እንስሳቶቻቸው እና ለዕለት ተዕለት ኑሯቸው የሚያስፈልገውን ውኃ እጥረት ይበልጥ ያባብሰዋል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የፕሮጀክቱ ባለቤቶች ታዳሽ ኃይል እና ውኃ ቆጣቢ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን እንደሚጠቀሙ ቢገልጹም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ በውኃ ሀብታቸው ላይ ሊደርስ ስለሚችለው ተፅዕኖ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Keenyaan karoora fayyadama teeknooloojii aritifishal intelejensii (AI) cimsuuf, dhaabbilee Maaykiroosoftii fi G-42 waliin ta'uun buufata daataa gurguddaa Naayvaashaatti ijaaruuf qophoofteetti. Haa ta'u malee, jiraattonni naannichaa, proojektiin kun hanqina bishaanii isaanii duraan iyyuu qunname akka hammaatuufi beeyiladoota isaanii irratti dhiibbaa akka geessisu sodaatu. Dhaabbileen kunniin humna haaromsuufi teeknooloojii bishaan qusatu akka fayyadaman waadaa seenanis, hawaasni naannichaa ga'umsa qabeenya bishaanii isaanii irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabu.

title: Ebola cases in DRC hit 5,515 as Pope Leo urges global action to save lives
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,515 cases with a high fatality rate of nearly 48 percent. Pope Leo has appealed for urgent international assistance to combat the crisis, which is further complicated by regional conflict and infrastructure challenges. Although vaccination efforts are underway, global health officials emphasize that the response must be significantly increased to stop the spread of the virus.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ቁጥር 5,515 ደርሷል፤ ይህም የሞት ምጣኔው ወደ 48 በመቶ እንዲያድግ አድርጓል። ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ በግጭትና በችግር የታጀበውን ይህን ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የክትባት ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ ቢሆንም፣ ቫይረሱን ለመግታት ዓለም አቀፍ የጤና ተቋማት ምላሹ አሁን ካለው በሁለት እና በሶስት እጥፍ ሊጨምር እንደሚገባ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa Rippabliika Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti babal’ateen namootni 5,515 qabamuun isaanii fi namootni 2,642 du’uun isaanii ibsameera. Paappaas Liiyoon rakkoo kana dhaabsisuuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa akka barbaachisu kan gaafatan yoo ta’u, dhibichis walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa fi hanqina bu’uuraalee misoomaatiin hammeenyaan itti fufee jira. Hanga ammaatti talaalliiwwan gahaa ta’an qaqqabanis, dhaabbileen fayyaa idil-addunyaa tattaaffiin hanga amma taasifamaa jiru gahaa waan hin taaneef, deebiin kennamu dachaa lama ykn sadiin dabaluu akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: India crushes cockroach dissent as ‘Fix Schools’ campaign riles Modi
english: The Cockroach Janta Party is facing significant resistance from the Indian government and BJP supporters for its initiative to monitor and improve state-run schools. Volunteers conducting these inspections have been targeted by attacks and legal intervention by authorities who claim the school visits are unauthorized. This confrontation highlights growing tensions over public school conditions and the government's response to civilian oversight.
amharic: የኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ በመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች ላይ ክትትል በማድረግ ለውጥ ለማምጣት የሚያደርገው ጥረት በመንግስት እና በገዢው ፓርቲ ደጋፊዎች ዘንድ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ትምህርት ቤቶችን የሚጎበኙ በጎ ፈቃደኞች ጥቃት እየደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ጉብኝቶቹ ህገወጥ ናቸው በሚል ህጋዊ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰዱ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ሁኔታ የመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች አቅም እና በዜጎች ቁጥጥር ላይ ያለው የመንግስት አቋም ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ ውስጥ መግባቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin 'Cockroach Janta' jedhamu manneen barnoota mootummaa fooyyessuuf yaalii inni godhu hoggantoota mootummaa fi deggertoota paartii biyya bulchu biratti mormiin guddaan irra ga'aa jira. Hayyoonni fedhii isaaniitiin manneen barnootaa kana sakatta'an miidhaa fi tarkaanfiin poolisii akka irratti fudhatamu taasifamaa jira; mootummaan immoo daawwannaan kun seeraan alaa dha jedha. Wali-dhabdeen kun haala manneen barnoota mootummaa fi akkaataa mootummaan hordoffii ummataa itti ilaalutti rakkoo jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Iranian cyber attack shuts down UK power plant for four days, report says
english: A small British power plant was forced to close for four days following a cyber attack attributed to Iranian hackers. While officials confirmed the incident, they stated that the broader national energy grid remained secure and unaffected. This event coincides with similar digital attacks targeting water infrastructure across the United States.
amharic: ኢራንን ከሚደግፉ ጠላፊዎች (ሀከሮች) በተሰነዘረ የሳይበር ጥቃት ምክንያት በብሪታንያ የሚገኝ አንድ አነስተኛ የኃይል ማመንጫ ለስድስት ቀናት ያህል ተዘግቶ ነበር። የብሪታንያ ባለሥልጣናት ጉዳዩን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን ጥቃቱ በአገሪቱ አጠቃላይ የኃይል አቅርቦት ላይ ምንም ዓይነት ስጋት እንዳልፈጠረ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት በአሜሪካ የውሃ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከደረሱ ተመሳሳይ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች ጋር ተያይዞ ተከስቷል።
oromo: Hackeronni Iran waliin hidhata qaban, buufata humna ibsaa xiqqaa tokko irratti miidhaa geessisuun guyyoota afuriif akka cufamu godhaniiru. Mootummaan Biritish akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun buufata sanatti malee guddina humna ibsaa biyyattii irratti balaa hin geessisne. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo buufataalee bishaanii Ameerikaa irratti haleellaan wal-fakkaataan geggeeffamaa turetti dha.

title: Less than 20 ships transit Strait of Hormuz over weekend
english: Data indicates that fewer than 20 ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend. While 17 vessels were officially recorded, the exact number is likely higher because some ships turned off their tracking devices. This vital maritime route remains a point of observation due to these navigational inconsistencies.
amharic: በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ከ20 በታች የሚሆኑ መርከቦች የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ማለፋቸውን መረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። በይፋ የተመዘገቡት 17 መርከቦች ቢሆኑም፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች መከታተያ መሳሪያዎቻቸውን በማጥፋታቸው ትክክለኛው ቁጥር ከዚህ በላይ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገልጿል። ይህ ወሳኝ የባህር መስመር በመርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ በሚታዩ እርግጠኛ ባልሆኑ ሁኔታዎች ምክንያት በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon akka agarsiisutti, dhuma torban darbe kana markaboonni 20 gadi ta'an qofa harka galaana Hormuz darbeera. Lakkoofsi seera qabeessa ta'e markaboota 17 ta'us, markaboonni tokko tokko meeshaa ittiin of hordofan waan cufataniif lakkoofsi sirrii ta'e sanaa ol ta'uu danda'a. Daandiin galaanaa barbaachisaan kun sochiin markabootaa ifa waan hin taaneef xiyyeeffannoo keessa jira.

title: Large forest fire burns close to residential areas in Ankara
english: A significant forest fire has broken out near the Mamak district on the edge of Ankara, Turkey. The blaze is currently posing a direct threat to nearby residential properties. Emergency crews are working to manage the situation as the fire spreads close to human settlements.
amharic: በቱርክ ዋና ከተማ አንካራ ዳርቻ በሚገኘው ማማክ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የደን ቃጠሎ ተቀስቅሷል። እሳቱ በአካባቢው ወደሚገኙ የመኖሪያ ቤቶች በመጠጋቱ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች እሳቱ ወደ መኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እንዳይዛመት ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa guddittii Turkiyii Ankaraa keessatti, naannoo Maamaakitti ibiddee bosonaa cimaan ka'ee jira. Ibidni kun maneen jireenyaa naannichatti argaman irratti balaa agarsiisaa jira. Hojjettoonni humna ittisa balaa ibidicha gara maneen jireenyaatti akka hin babal'anne to'achuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Tokayev allies head for landslide victory in Kazakhstan elections
english: President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s political allies are poised for a massive victory in Kazakhstan's latest parliamentary elections, with exit polls showing his party securing roughly 70 percent of the vote. This overwhelming success further strengthens the President's control over the nation. The outcome reinforces Tokayev's authority in the resource-rich country, which maintains strategic partnerships with China and Russia.
amharic: በካዛክስታን በተካሄደው የፓርላማ ምርጫ የፕሬዚዳንት ካሲም-ጆማርት ቶካየቭ አጋር የሆኑት ፓርቲዎች ሰፊ ድል እየተቀዳጁ መሆኑን ከምርጫ ጣቢያዎች የተገኙ መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። የፕሬዚዳንቱ ፓርቲ ወደ 70 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ድምፅ በማግኘት በሀገሪቱ ላይ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ የበለጠ አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ውጤት ሩሲያ እና ቻይና ጋር ጠንካራ ግንኙነት ባላት በዚህ ሀብታም ሀገር የፕሬዚዳንት ቶካየቭን ስልጣን ከፍ ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Filannoo paarlaamaa Kaazaakhistaanirratti deeggartonni pirezidaant Kaassim-Joomart Tookaayeew injifannoo guddaa gonfachuuf deemaa jiru. Akka odeeffannoo irraa hubatamutti, paartiin pirezidaantichaa sagalee harka 70 ol argachuun isaanii aangoo isaanii caalaatti cimsuuf gargaara. Bu'aan kun biyya qabeenya uumamaatiin badhaadheefi hariiroo cimaa Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa waliin qabdu kana keessatti aangoo pirezidaantichaa daran jabeessa.

title: Israeli drone strike kills two in central Gaza
english: Two Palestinian men were killed early Monday following an Israeli drone attack on a camp for displaced people in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza. Additional airstrikes and artillery fire were reported near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital and the Maghazi refugee camp. These ongoing military operations occur amid a conflict that has caused tens of thousands of casualties since late 2023.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በዴይር አል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ከአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል አቅራቢያ እና ማጋዚ የስደተኞች ካምፕ አቅጣጫዎች ተጨማሪ የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶች ተከስተዋል። እነዚህ ቀጣይነት ያላቸው ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እ.ኤ.አ. ከ2023 መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እና ቀውስ ያስከተለውን ጦርነት አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Dilbata gara Wiixataatti ce'uun, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) Israa'el ganda Deir al-Balah, giddu-galeessa Gaazaatti raawwattee namoota lamatu ajjeeffame. Haleellaan xiyyaara waraanaa fi meeshaa gurguddaa biraas hospitaala Al-Aqsaa fi ganda baqattootaa Magaazii biratti gabaafameera. Haleellaan kun hundi, waraana bara 2023 irraa eegalee lubbuu namoota kumaatamaa galaafate keessatti kan itti fufe dha.

title: Israeli forces storm Syria’s Quneitra, detain a civilian
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid into the Quneitra province located in southern Syria this past Sunday. During this operation, soldiers captured and detained a local civilian who was working as a shepherd. This incident marks another instance of cross-border activity between the two nations.

Additionally, there has been no official information provided regarding the number of casualties resulting from these attacks.

title: Iran war live: Iranian parliament advances plans for Hormuz service fees
english: The Iranian parliament is moving forward with a new proposal that would require international ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz to pay service fees to Tehran. This development comes amid rising tensions, as the U.S. government expresses its intention to cut off Iran’s economic resources. The proposed legislation aims to establish a formal system for charging vessels that navigate these critical waters.

title: Watch: Iranians express mixed opinions over war recovery
english: Iranians in Tehran are showing conflicting views regarding the country's path forward following recent military strikes and rising tensions with the United States. This reaction follows President Trump's efforts to further isolate Iran through increased economic sanctions.

title: Raphinha and Lopez score braces as Barcelona trounce Elche 5-0
english: Barcelona started their La Liga title defense with an impressive 5-0 victory over Elche. Despite resting several key players, Barcelona dominated the match and secured a confident win to signal their intent for the season.

title: Yemen, US officials meet to discuss ‘countering Houthi propaganda’
english: Yemeni and American officials recently met to discuss strategies for combating the spread of misinformation by Houthi rebels. The leaders emphasized that providing accurate information is vital to their ongoing security efforts. This discussion occurred alongside active military operations by the Yemeni government against Houthi targets following continued maritime attacks in the Red Sea.

title: Syria confirms US-mediated talks with Israel in Jordan to ease tensions
english: Syrian and Israeli officials recently held high-level discussions in Jordan facilitated by the United States to reduce regional tensions. The parties explored the creation of a U.S.-monitored security center to prevent accidental military clashes, particularly involving Turkey. Syria emphasized that it still views the Golan Heights as its territory and prioritized a return to military boundaries established prior to December 2024.

title: Will Donald Trump’s new sanctions against Iran work?
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to implement severe economic sanctions against Iran as part of a strategy to isolate the nation. Washington is actively urging other countries to participate in this coordinated campaign to pressure the Iranian government. In response, Iran has warned that any nation that joins these US-led efforts will be viewed as an adversary.

title: Serbia requests international assistance to battle wildfires
english: Serbia has officially asked for international help to contain severe wildfires currently spreading across the Balkan region. The government is seeking support from both the European Union and Russia to manage the escalating situation. Emergency crews are working to gain control as the fires continue to pose a significant threat.

title: US envoy Tom Barrack retracts comment that Syria’s Golan is occupied
english: US Ambassador Tom Barrack has retracted his recent statement acknowledging that the Golan Heights is occupied Syrian territory. After facing criticism from pro-Israel groups, he clarified that the official US policy remains committed to recognizing Israel's sovereignty over the area. This policy was originally established by Donald Trump in 2019 and continues to be maintained by the current administration.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አምባሳደር ቶም ባራክ የጎላን ኮረብታ የተያዘ የሶሪያ ግዛት ነው ብለው የተናገሩትን ንግግር መልሰው ሰርዘዋል። በእስራኤል ደጋፊዎች ዘንድ ተቃውሞ ከገጠማቸው በኋላ፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት የእስራኤልን የጎላን ኮረብታ የሉዓላዊነት ይገባኛል የመቀበል ፖሊሲ እንደማይቀየር አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ፖሊሲ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2019 በዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተጀመረ ሲሆን አሁንም በሥራ ላይ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Tom Baaraak, naannoon Goolaan kan Siiriyaa fi biyya qabamee jiru dha jechuun dubbatan duraan turan sana kaasaniiru. Hordoftoota Israa'el biratti qeeqa guddaa erga isaan qunnamee booda, Ameerikaan naannicha irratti mirga abbummaa Israa'el beekuu ishee akka itti fuftu ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun siyaasa bara 2019 Doolaaldi Tiraampiin eegaleefi hanga ammaatti hojii irra jiru ta'uu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Israel is using children’s kites as pretext to strike Gaza: Hamas
english: Hamas has accused Israel of using the launch of paper kites from Gaza as an excuse to launch new military strikes. Israel recently set a three-day deadline for these activities to stop, warning of potential evacuations and air raids if they continue. In response, Hamas officials described the Israeli threats as an attack on children and urged international bodies to intervene to protect the current ceasefire.
amharic: ሀማስ እስራኤል ከጋዛ የሚለቀቁ የወረቀት የዓይሮፕላን መጫወቻዎችን እንደ ሰበብ በመጠቀም በጋዛ ላይ አዲስ ጥቃት ለመፈጸም እያቀደች ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። እስራኤል እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ካልቆሙ በአየር ጥቃት እንደሚወስድ የሶስት ቀናት ቀነ-ገደብ ሰጥታለች። የሀማስ ቃል አቀባይ ይህን ድርጊት በህጻናት ላይ የሚደረግ ዛቻ ነው በማለት ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ተኩስ አቁሙ እንዲጠበቅ ግፊት እንዲያደርጉ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hamaas, Israa'el qilleensa irratti kan gadhiifaman warqiiwwan xiyyaaraa (kites) sababa godhachuun Gaazaarratti haleellaa haarawaa raawwachuuf karoorfatte jettee himatteetti. Israa'el hojiin kun guyyaa sadii keessatti yoo dhaabachuu baate haleellaa qilleensaa fi arii'annaa akka raawwattu akeekkachiiseetti. Dubbi himaan Hamaas gochi kun ijoollee irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha jedhee, qaamonni idil-addunyaa walii-galtee dhaabbii waraanaaf jiru akka kabachiisan gaafateera.

title: Landfill collapse kills 30 in Guinea’s capital after heavy rains
english: In Conakry, Guinea, a tragic landfill collapse caused by intense rain has claimed the lives of at least 30 people. The massive pile of trash slid onto residential areas, leaving many others injured and trapped. Emergency responders are currently working through the debris to search for additional victims.
amharic: በጊኒ ዋና ከተማ ኮናክሪ፣ በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የቆሻሻ መጣያ ቦታ በመፍረሱ ቢያንስ 30 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የፈረሰው ግዙፍ የቆሻሻ ክምር በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ በመውደቁ ለበርካታ ሰዎች መቁሰል እና መፈናቀል ምክንያት ሆኗል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በስፍራው ተገኝተው የነፍስ አድን ስራቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Giinii, Konakriitti, rooba cimaa robeen walqabatee bakki gowwaa gubbaa caccabuu isaatiin lubbuun namoota 30 ol darbeera. Caccabbiin xurii kanaa mana jireenyaa ollaa jiran irratti waan bu'eef, namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa iddoo sana gahuun namoota biroo barbaaduu fi gargaaruu itti fufaniiru.

title: EU calls on Israel to halt E1 settlement plan, address settler violence
english: The European Union has demanded that Israel cancel its E1 housing project in the West Bank, noting that such expansion threatens a potential two-state solution. Additionally, the EU expressed deep concern over rising violence by settlers against Palestinians and urged the Israeli government to hold those responsible accountable. This stance reflects the international community's broad opposition to settlement activities, which are widely considered illegal under global law.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት እስራኤል በምዕራብ ባንክ በምታቅደው የኢ-1 ሰፈራ ግንባታ ፕሮጀክት እንድታቆም ጠይቋል። ህብረቱ ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የሁለት ሀገራት መፍትሄን አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል በመግለጽ፣ በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን የስደተኞች ጥቃትም አውግዟል። የእስራኤል መንግስትም በሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት እንዲያስቆምና ተጠያቂነትን እንዲያረጋግጥ ህብረቱ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa mootummaan Israa'el iddoo E1 jedhamuutti ganda ijaaruuf karoorse akka dhaabdu gaafateera. Ijaarsi kun rakkoo biyyoota lamaa gidduutti furmaata argamsiisuu danda'u irratti gufuu akka ta'u ibsameera. Kana malees, gamtichi ganda ijaartootni kunniin qe'ee Falastiinotaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiran akka dhaabanii fi namoota yakka raawwatan irratti tarkaanfiin akka fudhatamu gaafateera.

title: Iranian parliamentary committee approves provision to charge ships in Hormuz
english: A committee within the Iranian parliament has approved a proposal to begin charging fees to ships transiting through the Strait of Hormuz. These payments would cover various services, including safety, fuel, and environmental protection for vessels passing through the waterway. The draft legislation must now pass a full parliamentary vote and receive final constitutional approval before it can be enacted.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ ኮሚቴ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ በሚያልፉ መርከቦች ላይ ክፍያ ለመጣል የሚያስችል ረቂቅ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ ህግ መርከቦች በሰርጡ ውስጥ ሲያልፉ ለሚሰጡ እንደ ነዳጅ፣ የደህንነት እና የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ላሉ አገልግሎቶች ክፍያ እንዲከፍሉ ያስገድዳል። ረቂቅ ህጉ በፓርላማ ሙሉ ድምጽ ተቀባይነት ካገኘ በኋላ በህገ-መንግስቱ መሰረት ተግባራዊ ከመሆኑ በፊት የመጨረሻ ማረጋገጫ ይፈልጋል።
oromo: Koreen mana maree biyyattii Iraan, markaboota qaxxaamuraa Hormuz keessa darban irratti kaffaltii murteessuuf karoorfateera. Kaffaltiin kun tajaajiloota akka boba'aa, eegumsa fayyummaa fi nageenyaa markaboota darbaniif kan oolu ta'a. Seerri kun hanga mana maree guutuun ragga'ee fi mirkaneeffannaa dhumaa argatutti hojiirra hin oolu.

title: Is Israel about to split the occupied West Bank in half?
english: Israel is advancing the 'E1' plan, a controversial initiative that involves developing land in the occupied West Bank. Critics warn that this project could physically divide the territory, effectively preventing the creation of a viable and contiguous future Palestinian state. The plan remains a major point of contention due to its potential to permanently alter the region's geopolitical landscape.
amharic: እስራኤል በምዕራብ ባንክ የምትፈጽመውን 'E1' የተሰኘ አወዛጋቢ የመሬት ልማት እቅድ ለማራመድ እየተንቀሳቀሰች ነው። ይህ እቅድ የፍልስጤም ግዛትን በሁለት በመክፈል ለወደፊት ነጻ እና የተሳሰረ የፍልስጤም ሀገር የመመስረት እድልን በእጅጉ እንደሚያደናቅፍ ተገልጿል። ይህም በክልሉ ላይ ዘላቂ የሆነ የፖለቲካ እና የጂኦግራፊያዊ ለውጥ ሊያመጣ እንደሚችል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Israa'el karoora 'E1' jedhamu kan lafa Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) irratti hojjetamu jabeessitee itti fufaa jirti. Karoorri kun lafa kana bakka lamatti hiruu danda'a kan jedhame yoo ta'u, kunis gara fuulduraatti biyya Falasxiin kan taate walitti hidhamtee ijaaramuu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'a. Hojiiwwan kunis haala siyaas-lafaa naannichaa yeroo dheeraaf jijjiiruu waan danda'uuf mormii guddaan irratti ka'aa jira.

title: Severe winds toss four aircraft across Italian airport tarmac
english: Extremely powerful winds reaching 120 km/h struck an airport in Forlì, Italy, causing significant damage. The gusts were strong enough to push and flip four light aircraft that were parked on the tarmac. As a result of these dangerous conditions, airport operations were temporarily halted for one hour.
amharic: በጣሊያን ፎርሊ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በሰዓት 120 ኪሎ ሜትር ፍጥነት ያለው ኃይለኛ ነፋስ በመነሳቱ በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው የነበሩ አራት ትናንሽ አውሮፕላኖች ተገልብጠዋል። በዚህ አስከፊ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት የአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው ለአንድ ሰዓት ያህል አገልግሎት መስጠት አቋርጦ ነበር።
oromo: Buufata xiyyaaraa biyya Xaaliyaanii kan ta'e Forlii keessatti bubbeen hamma dhibba tokko fi digdamii (120) km/h ga'u xiyyaarota xixiqqoo afur lafa irra turan fonqolcheera. Haala qilleensaa hamaa kanaan walqabatee, buufanni xiyyaaraa sun yeroof sa'aatii tokkoof tajaajila addaan kutee ture.

title: Photos: IndyCars speed past Washington landmarks as part of Freedom 250
english: The inaugural Freedom 250 IndyCar race took place in Washington, DC, featuring drivers racing past iconic sites like the US Capitol and the Washington Monument. Established by President Donald Trump to celebrate the nation's 250th anniversary, the event drew large crowds for a challenging 250-mile street circuit. Alex Palou secured the pole position for this historic race, which showcased high-speed motor racing in the heart of the American capital.
amharic: የመጀመሪያው የፍሪደም 250 ኢንዲካር ውድድር በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የተካሄደ ሲሆን ተሽከርካሪዎቹ እንደ አሜሪካ ካፒቶል እና ዋሽንግተን ሀውልት ባሉ ታዋቂ ቦታዎች አጠገብ ተሽቀዳድመዋል። የዩናይትድ ስቴትስን 250ኛ ዓመት የምስረታ በዓል ለማክበር በፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተጀመረው ይህ ውድድር፣ በከተማው ጎዳናዎች ላይ 250 ማይል ርቀት ተሸፍኗል። አሌክስ ፓሎ ለዚህ ታሪካዊ ውድድር ቀዳሚውን ስፍራ በመያዝ፣ በዋና ከተማዋ እምብርት ላይ የተከናወነውን ይህንን የፍጥነት ውድድር በበላይነት መርቷል።
oromo: Guyyaan wal-dorgommii konkolaataa Freedom 250 jedhamu magaalaa Washington DC keessatti kan jalqabame yoo ta'u, dorgomtoonni kunis bakkeewwan seena-qabeeyyii kan akka US Capitol fi yaadannoo Washington bira darbanii fiiganiiru. Ayyaana waggaa 250ffaa biyyattii kabajuuf Pireezidaant Donald Trumpin kan qophaa'e dorgommiin kun, namoota hedduu kan hawwate yoo ta'u, daandiiwwan magaalattii keessa qaxxaamuruun maayila 250 kan haguuge dha. Alex Palou dorgommii seenaa qabeessa kana irratti iddoo jalqabaa kan qabate yoo ta'u, dorgommiin kunis ganda guddoo Ameerikaa keessatti saffisaan kan raawwatame dha.

title: Gaza’s hospitals are running out of oxygen as healthcare nears collapse
english: Gaza's healthcare system is on the verge of total failure due to severe oxygen shortages. Ongoing military attacks and restrictions on incoming supplies have severely limited the operation of life-saving medical equipment. Consequently, vulnerable patients, including newborns and those in critical condition, are at extreme risk of losing their lives.
amharic: በጋዛ የጤና አገልግሎት ሥርዓት በኦክስጅን አቅርቦት እጥረት ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመፈራረስ አደጋ ተጋርጦበታል። ቀጥተኛ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች እና የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች ወደ ውስጥ እንዳይገቡ መደረጉ ለታካሚዎች ህይወት አድን አገልግሎት መስጠትን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። በዚህም ምክንያት አዲስ የተወለዱ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በጽኑ የታመሙ ታካሚዎች ለከፍተኛ የሞት አደጋ ተጋልጠዋል።
oromo: Sirni fayyaa Gaaza keessaa dhabamuu oksijiiniin gahuu dhabuu irraa kan ka'e hanga kufaatii gahee jira. Hojiin waraanaa fi daangaan meeshaaleen yaalaa akka hin galle dhorkamuun tajaajilli fayyaa akka danqamu godheera. Kanaan kan ka'e, daa'imman dhalootaan fi namoonni dhukkuba cimaa keessa jiran jireenya isaanii irratti balaa hamaa keessa galanii jiru.

title: Two killed after giant Ganesha statue collapses onto crowd in Mumbai
english: A tragic accident occurred in Mumbai, India, when a massive Ganesha statue collapsed into a crowd of people. The incident took place during a street procession as part of the traditional Ganesh Chaturthi festival. Unfortunately, two individuals lost their lives, and five others sustained injuries during the event.
amharic: በህንድ ሙምባይ ከተማ በጋነሽ ቻቱርቲ በዓል አከባበር ወቅት ግዙፍ የጋነሽ ምስል በሰው ብዛት ላይ በመውደቁ አሳዛኝ አደጋ ደርሷል። በዚህ ክስተት ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በዓሉ ምእመናን ምስሎቹን ወደ ባህር ከመውሰዳቸው በፊት በጎዳናዎች ላይ ሲያዘዋውሩ የሚከበር ነው።
oromo: Indiyaa, magaalaa Mumbayitti ayyaana Gaaneesh Chaaturtii kabajuu irratti, namoota baay'ee irratti fakkii Gaaneesh guddaan tokko kufuun isaa balaa suukanneessaa geessiseera. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota lamaa yoo darbu, namoonni shan ammoo miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate, amantootni fakkiilee kana gara galaanaatti gadi dhiisuu isaanii dura karaa irra deddeebi'aa turan irratti.

title: Washington enters ‘new phase’ in Iran war, US House speaker says
english: US House Speaker Mike Johnson announced that the United States is beginning a new stage in its conflict with Iran. He expressed confidence that allied countries will support this upcoming effort to resolve the situation. Johnson also emphasized that Iran cannot be relied upon in diplomatic talks and credited former President Trump with successfully preventing them from obtaining nuclear capabilities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ ማይክ ጆንሰን፣ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ባላት ግጭት አዲስ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ መግባቷን አስታውቀዋል። ይህን ቀውስ ለመፍታት በሚደረገው ቀጣይ ጥረት አጋር ሀገራት ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ኢራንን ማመን እንደማይቻል የገለጹት አፈ-ጉባኤው፣ የኢራን የኒውክሌር መርሃ ግብር እንዳይሳካ የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የነበራቸውን አስተዋጽኦ ጠቅሰዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoon Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummata Ameerikaa Maayik Jonsan, Ameerikaan walitti bu'iinsa Iraan wajjin qabdu keessatti gara sadarkaa haaraatti ce'aa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Dhimma kana xumuruuf adeemsa itti aanu keessatti biyyoonni michoota ta'an deeggarsa akka kennan amananii jiru. Jonsan marii diippilomaasii irratti Iraan amanamuu akka hin dandeenye kan dubbatan yoo ta'u, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne ittisuu irratti gahee pirezidaantii duraanii Traamp qaban galateeffataniiru.

title: Israel warns of strikes, evacuations over kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza
english: The Israeli government has threatened to launch airstrikes and force evacuations in Gaza due to Palestinian children flying kites, which officials now classify as acts of war. Despite reports confirming these kites carry no explosives and pose no physical threat, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz have ordered a forceful response. They view these toys as security threats comparable to drones and are pressuring Hamas to stop the activity within three days.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማዊ ህጻናት የሰሩትን የጨዋታ ወረቀት በራሪ (ካይት) እንደ ጦርነት ድርጊት በመቁጠር በአካባቢው የአየር ጥቃት እና የሰዎች መፈናቀል እንደሚኖር አስጠንቅቋል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ወረቀቶች ምንም አይነት አደገኛ ቁስ እንደሌላቸው እና ስጋት እንደማይፈጥሩ ቢረጋገጥም፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና መከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ እስራኤል ካትዝ ጥቃቱን በኃይል ለመመከት ወስነዋል። መንግስቱ እነዚህን መጫወቻዎች እንደ ድሮን በመቁጠር ሃማስ በሶስት ቀናት ውስጥ እንዲያስቆማቸው አዝዘዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el ijoolleen Falasxiin Gaazaatti shumburree ykn 'kaayiti' balaliisuun isaanii akka gocha waraanaatti lakkaa'amee tarkaanfiin akka fudhatamuufi namootni naannichaa akka gadi lakkisan akeekkachiiseera. Shumburreen kunneen miidhaa kan hin geessisneefi meeshaa waraanaa kan hin qabne ta'us, ministirri muummee Biniyaamii Neetaanyaahuufi ministirri ittisaa Israa'el Kaatz tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf murteessaniiru. Mootummaan kun shumburree kana akka doonii waraanaatti ilaaluun, haala kana guyyaa sadii keessatti akka dhaabsisuuf haamaas irratti dhiibbaa gochaa jira.

title: Israel warns of strikes, evacuations over kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza
english: Israel has issued a three-day ultimatum to Hamas to stop the launching of kites, balloons, and drones from Gaza into its territory. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and defense officials have threatened to launch intense airstrikes and force residents to evacuate from areas where these devices originate. Despite reports that these objects have not caused any actual harm, Israeli authorities maintain that they will take aggressive military action against those responsible.
amharic: እስራኤል ከጋዛ ወደ ግዛቷ የሚለቀቁትን የካይት (የወረቀት ስውር), የፊኛ እና የድሮን እንቅስቃሴ እንዲቆም ለሃማስ የሶስት ቀን ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥታለች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ እና የመከላከያ ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ካልቆሙ ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት እንደሚሰነዝሩ እና ከሚመለከታቸው አካባቢዎች ነዋሪዎችን እንደሚያፈናቅሉ አስታውቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ቁሳቁሶች ምንም አይነት ጉዳት አላደረሱም ቢባልም፣ እስራኤል በኃይል ለመውሰድ እና ተጠያቂዎችን ለማጥቃት ቆርጣ መነሳቷን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Isra'el ergaa cimaa guyyaa sadii Hamasif dabarsite keessatti, Gaza irraa kaayitiin, pufiniin fi doonni gara biyyattii gadi lakkifaman akka dhaabbatan akeekkachiisteetti. Ministirri Muummee Benjamin Netanyahu fi hoggantoonni nageenyaa, gochi kun yoo hin dhaabbanne, haleellaa qilleensa irraa kan cimaa ta'e akka raawwatan fi bakka gadi lakkifaman kanneen irraa namoota akka buqqaasan ibsaniiru. Wantoonni kunneen miidhaa cimaa geessisuu baatanis, mootummaan Isra'el tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf fi warra duuba jiran irratti duuluuf murteeffatteetti.

title: Israeli forces open fire on Palestinians across West Bank in separate incidents
english: Israeli forces were involved in multiple violent incidents across the West Bank on Sunday, resulting in the arrest of a teenager and the shooting of two others. One Palestinian man was injured near Taybeh after an alleged attempt to take a soldier's weapon, while a 14-year-old boy was killed by gunfire in the Askar refugee camp. Local community leaders have contested the military's justifications for these actions, citing a lack of provocation in the fatal shooting of the minor.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተፈጠሩ ተከታታይ ግጭቶች አንድ ታዳጊን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን በሌሎች ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ላይም ተኩስ ከፍተዋል። በታይቤህ አቅራቢያ የጦር መሳሪያ ለመንጠቅ ሞክሯል በተባለ ሰው ላይ በተወሰደው እርምጃ አንድ ሰው ሲቆስል፣ በአስካር መጠለያ ጣቢያ ውስጥ ግን አንድ የ14 ዓመት ልጅ በጥይት ተገድሏል። የአካባቢው የሕዝብ ተወካዮች የሕፃኑ መገደል ምንም አይነት ምክንያት ያልነበረው እና ተገቢ ያልሆነ ድርጊት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe naannoo Qarree Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti loltoonni Israa’el walitti bu’iinsa garaagaraa uumaniin dargaggeessa tokko hidhaniiru, namoota biroo lama irratti ammoo dhukaasa bananiiru. Namni tokko naannoo Taybeh-tti meeshaa waraanaa fuudhuuf yaale jedhamee erga rukutamee booda miidhaan irra gaheera, dargaggeessi umriin isaa 14 ta’e tokko ammoo buufata baqattootaa Askar keessatti dhukaasaan ajjeefameera. Hogganoonni naannichaa dhukaasa mucicha irratti banamee fi ajjeechaa raawwatame fudhatama kan hin qabne fi sababa tokko malee kan raawwatame ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Mossad chief met Syrian foreign minister to ease tensions, Haaretz reports
english: The head of Israel's intelligence agency, Mossad, recently held discussions with the Syrian Foreign Minister. This meeting was intended to lower regional friction following an Israeli aerial attack on a Syrian military airfield. The diplomatic effort aims to prevent further escalation between the two nations.
amharic: የእስራኤል የደህንነት መስሪያ ቤት (ሞሳድ) ሃላፊ ከሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ጋር ተገናኝተው መክረዋል። ይህ ውይይት የተደረገው እስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ካደረሰች በኋላ የተፈጠረውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ ነው። የሁለቱ ወገኖች የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረት ግጭቱ እንዳይባባስ ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan waajjira odeeffannoo Israa'el (Mosaad) ministira dhimma alaa Suuriyaa waliin mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun kan gaggeeffame, Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa waraana Suuriyaa irratti erga haleeltee booda waldhabiinsa uumame hir'isuufi. Tattaaffiin dippiloomaasii kunis walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lamaan gidduutti akka hin hammaanne ittisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Zhou Bo: China’s alternative to Western power
english: Retired Chinese Senior Colonel Zhou Bo recently discussed China's desire to shift global influence away from a single superpower toward a multipolar system. He argues that Beijing aims to create a more balanced and equitable international order that better serves diverse nations. The discussion also examines whether China's actual geopolitical actions align with these stated diplomatic goals.
amharic: የቻይና የጦር ኃይል የጡረታ ባለስልጣን የሆኑት ዙ ቦ፣ ቻይና ዓለም አቀፍ ተጽዕኖን ከአንድ ዋና ሀይል ወደ ብዙ ወገን እንዲሸጋገር ያላትን ፍላጎት አብራርተዋል። ቤጂንግ የበለጠ ሚዛናዊ እና ለሁሉም ሀገራት ፍትሃዊ የሆነ የዓለም ስርዓት ለመፍጠር እንደምትጥር ገልጸዋል። በውይይቱ ወቅት የቻይና ተግባራዊ የውጭ ግንኙነት እንቅስቃሴዎች እነዚህን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች የሚመጥኑ መሆን አለመሆናቸውም ተፈትሸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Chaayinaa kan ta'an Zu Bo, Chaayinaan dhiibbaa biyyoolessaa biyya tokkoo qofa irraa gara sirna baay'ee-hawaasummaatti (multipolar) jijjiiruuf akka barbaaddu ibsaniiru. Beijing sirna addunyaa kan caalaatti madaalamaa fi biyyoota hundaaf haqa qabeessa ta'e ijaaruuf akka hojjettu dubbatu. Haata'u malee, gochi Chaayinaa kan addunyaa irratti raawwattu dubbii ishee kana wajjin wal-simataa akka ta'e irratti mariin ta'eera.

title: Palestinian teen killed in Israeli raid buried in Occupied West Bank
english: A 14-year-old Palestinian boy named Islam Ahmad Maher Ajouri has been laid to rest following his death during an Israeli military operation at the Askar Refugee Camp. Large crowds gathered to mourn the teenager as violence in the occupied West Bank continues to escalate. Official reports indicate that over 1,100 Palestinians have lost their lives at the hands of Israeli forces and settlers in the region since last year.
amharic: የ14 ዓመቱ ፍልስጤማዊ ታዳጊ ኢስላም አህመድ ማሄር አጁሪ በአስካር የስደተኞች ካምፕ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ከተገደለ በኋላ በስነስርዓት ተቀብሯል። የቀብር ስነ ስርዓቱ ላይ በርካታ ሰዎች የተገኙ ሲሆን፣ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ግጭቶች እየተባባሱ መጥተዋል። ካለፈው ዓመት ጀምሮ በእስራኤል ኃይሎችና ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከ1,100 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ሕይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: dargaggeessi umuriin isaa waggaa 14 kan ta'e Islam Ahmad Maher Ajouri, buufata baqattoota Askaritti waraana Israa'eliin ajjeefamee sirni awwaalchaa isaa raawwatameera. Namoonni hedduun sirna awwaalchaa kana irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, naannoo daangaa dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti jeequmsi ittuma fufeera. Akka gabaasaatti, bara darbee kaasee humnoota Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoota biyya alaatiin namoonni Falasxiin 1,100 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru.

title: Video: Thousands of families flee fighting in Sudan’s North Kordofan State
english: Escalating violence in Sudan’s North Kordofan State has forced thousands of families to abandon their homes in search of safety. Many displaced civilians, particularly mothers and children, have gathered in the city of El Obeid. These refugees are now facing a severe humanitarian crisis as they struggle to access basic necessities like food within overcrowded camps.
amharic: በሱዳን ሰሜን ኮርዶፋን ግዛት የተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤተሰቦች መኖሪያቸውን ጥለው እንዲሰደዱ አስገድዷቸዋል። አብዛኛዎቹ ተፈናቃዮች እናቶች እና ህጻናት ሲሆኑ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ኤል ኦቤይድ በተባለችው ከተማ ተጠልለዋል። በተጨናነቁ መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች የሚገኙት እነዚህ ተፈናቃዮች ለምግብ እና ለሌሎች መሰረታዊ ፍላጎቶች ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Godina Kordofan Kaabaa Sudaanitti walitti buiinsi uumame maatiiwwan kumaatamaan lakkaawaman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Baqattoonni hedduun haadhotii fi ijoollee kan ta'an yoo ta'u, amma magaalaa El Obeid keessatti qubataniiru. Buufataalee baqattootaa guutanii jiran kana keessatti, namoonni kunneen nyaataa fi gargaarsa namoomaa argachuu irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Trump has ‘run out of options’ in Iran war: Stephen Walt
english: International relations expert Stephen Walt argues that President Trump’s policies have weakened the United States rather than strengthening it. Walt describes the ongoing tensions with Iran as a stalemate where neither side is willing to back down or escalate further. Additionally, he expresses skepticism regarding the Middle East peace process, noting that neither U.S. political party is currently prepared to challenge Israel's expansionist policies.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት ምሁሩ ስቴፈን ዋልት የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ፖሊሲዎች አሜሪካን ከማጠናከር ይልቅ እያዳከሟት እንደሚገኙ ይከራከራሉ። በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ሁለቱም ወገኖች ወደ ጦርነት ሳይገቡ አንዱ የሌላውን መፈታት የሚጠባበቁበት የአቋራጭ መውጫ የሌለው አጣብቂኝ ውስጥ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ሁለቱም የአሜሪካ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች በእስራኤል ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር ፍላጎት ስለሌላቸው በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ዘላቂ የሰላም መፍትሄ ለማግኘት አስቸጋሪ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Ogeessi hariiroo idil-addunyaa Stephen Walt, imaammanni pirezidaant Traamp biyyattii cimsuu mannaa dadhabsiisaa jiraachuu isaa dubbatu. Walitti bu’iinsi Iraanii fi Ameerikaa gidduu jiru haala garmalee cimaa fi furmaata hin qabne keessa akka jiru, garuu gama lamaanuu tarkaanfii dabalataa fudhachuu akka hin barbaanne ibsu. Kana malees, paartiileen siyaasaa Ameerikaa lamaanuu Israa’eel irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf fedhii waan hin qabneef, rakkoo naannoo sanatti hiikaa dhugaa argachuun ulfaataa akka ta’e himaniiru.

title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 30
english: At least 30 people died after a large pile of garbage collapsed onto residential homes in Conakry, Guinea, following intense rainfall. Rescue teams, including the military, are actively searching the debris for survivors, as authorities fear the number of fatalities may increase. This tragic event occurred in the Dar-es-Salam district, where a similar disaster also caused multiple deaths back in 2017.
amharic: በጊኒ ዋና ከተማ ኮናክሪ በጣለ ከባድ ዝናብ ሳቢያ የተከመረ የቆሻሻ ተራራ በመደርመሱ ቢያንስ 30 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የሀገሪቱ መንግስት የፍለጋ እና የማዳን ስራዎችን እያከናወነ ሲሆን፣ ተጨማሪ ሰዎች በፍርስራሹ ውስጥ ሊኖሩ ስለሚችሉ የሟቾች ቁጥር ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ስጋት አለ። የዳር-ኤስ-ሰላም አካባቢ ነዋሪዎች ላይ የደረሰው ይህ አደጋ፣ ተመሳሳይ ክስተት በ2017 ዓ.ም ተከስቶ አስር ሰዎችን መቅጠፉ ይታወሳል።
oromo: Giniitti magaalaa Konakrii keessatti rooba cimaa booda ibiddi qulqulleeffannaa magaalaa kufee mana jireenyaa irra gahuun namoota 30 ol ajjeeseera. Mootummaan garee fayyadamaa fi waraana bobbaasee namoota darban barbaadaa jira; lakkoofsi namoota du'anii daran dabaluu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama. Balaan kun naannoo Daar-es-Salaam keessatti kan mudate yoo ta'u, bara 2017 keessas balaan akkasii nama 10 galaafatee ture.

title: Tunisia sees protests after migrant boat sinking kills eight
english: A boat carrying 15 Tunisian migrants sank off the southeastern coast while attempting to reach Italy, resulting in eight deaths and six people still missing. This tragedy has triggered public demonstrations in the town of Ben Guerdane. These protests reflect growing local frustration regarding ongoing economic hardship and poor public services in the country.
amharic: ወደ ጣሊያን ሲጓዙ የነበሩ 15 የቱኒዚያ ስደተኞችን የያዘ ጀልባ በሀገሪቱ ደቡብ ምስራቅ የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ በመስጠሙ ስምንት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ስድስት ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በቤን ጉርዳን ከተማ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። ተቃውሞዎቹ በሀገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ድህነት እና የህዝብ አገልግሎቶች መዳከም ተከትሎ የመጣውን ህዝባዊ ቁጣ የሚያንፀባርቁ ናቸው።
oromo: Dooniin namoota baqattoota biyya Tunisiyaa 15 of keessatti qabattee gara Xaaliyaaniitti imalaa turte qarqara galaana kibba-baha biyyattiitti lixuun, lubbuun namoota saddeetii akka darbe fi namoonni jahaan immoo akka badaniif sababa taate. Balaan kun magaalaa Ben Guerdane keessatti mormii uumee jira. Mormiin kun hiyyummaa dabalaa jiru fi tajaajila hawaasummaa hir'ataa dhufan irratti aarii uummanni qabu kan calaqqisiisu dha.

title: Thousands displaced as wildfire threatens homes in US state of Nevada
english: A rapidly growing wildfire known as the Hawk Fire has forced thousands of residents to evacuate their homes near Reno, Nevada. Driven by strong winds and dry conditions, the blaze has damaged several structures and caused widespread power outages throughout Washoe County. Authorities have declared a state of emergency and mobilized hundreds of personnel to combat the flames as they threaten residential areas and local infrastructure.
amharic: በኔቫዳ ግዛት እየተስፋፋ የሚገኘው የጫካ እሳት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎችን ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድዷል። በጠንካራ ንፋስ እና በደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት እየተባባሰ የመጣው ይህ እሳት በርካታ ቤቶችን በማቃጠሉ እና የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥን በማድረሱ በአካባቢው የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ታውጇል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም ደህንነታቸውን እንዲጠብቁ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa Reno, Nevada biratti hammaateen namoonni kumaatamaa ta'an manneen isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Qilleensa cimaa fi haala qilleensa gogogaa kanaan ibiddisi dafee babal'achaa waan jiruuf, mana jireenyaa fi tajaajila elektirikii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Mootummaan naannichaa haala rakkisaa kana hordofee labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa kan labse yoo ta'u, humnoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Iran war: Top US lawmaker says Republicans can ‘absolutely’ win midterms
english: US House Speaker Mike Johnson remains confident that the Republican Party will maintain control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections, despite public dissatisfaction with the ongoing war against Iran. While Johnson believes a victory is certain regardless of the conflict's status, he acknowledged that concluding the war before the November vote would be beneficial. The administration continues to defend the military action as a necessary step to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons, even though public opinion polls show that most Americans want the fighting to stop.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ ማይክ ጆንሰን በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ምክንያት የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ቢኖርም፣ ሪፐብሊካኖች በመጪው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ የኮንግረስ ቁጥጥራቸውን እንደሚይዙ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። ጆንሰን ጦርነቱ ቢቀጥልም ድል እንደሚቀዳጁ ቢናገሩም፣ ከምርጫው በፊት ጦርነቱ ቢቆም እንደሚሻል አምነዋል። አስተዳደሩ ጦርነቱን ኢራን የኑክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል የተደረገ አስፈላጊ እርምጃ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን ግን ጦርነቱ እንዲያበቃ እንደሚፈልጉ የህዝብ አስተያየት ጥናቶች ያመለክታሉ።
oromo: Itti-aanaan mana maree bakka bu'oota ummataa Ameerikaa Maayik Jonson, waraana Iraan irratti geggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee mormiin ummataa jiraatus, paartiin Ripaabilikaanii filannoo dhufu irratti to'annoo mana maree akka qabatu abdiin qaba jedhaniiru. Jonson waraanni sun osoo hin xumuraminillee injifannoon ni argama jedhanii kan amanan ta'us, filannoo Sadaasaa duratti xumuramuun gaarii akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Mootummaan waraana kana Iraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan lolu ta'us, qorannoon yaadni ummataa akka agarsiisutti lammiileen Ameerikaa hedduun waraanni sun hatattamaan dhaabbachuu akka qabu yaadu.

title: Landfill collapse in Guinea kills at least 22 people
english: A massive pile of trash collapsed at a major landfill in Conakry, Guinea, after heavy rainfall triggered a landslide. The debris buried nearby homes, resulting in at least 22 confirmed deaths. Local authorities are continuing rescue efforts, though they worry the final casualty count could rise further.
amharic: በጊኒ ዋና ከተማ ኮናክሪ በሚገኝ ትልቅ የቆሻሻ መጣያ ቦታ ላይ በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የተፈጠረ የመሬት መንሸራተት ቢያንስ 22 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። የቆሻሻ ክምር መደርመሱ በአካባቢው የነበሩ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን በመቅበሩ የሟቾች ቁጥር ሊጨምር እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የፍለጋ እና የነፍስ አድን ስራቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Gini, magaalaa guddittii Konakrii keessatti lafa qulqulleessa qoshaa guddaa ta'e tokkorratti roobni cimaan roobeen lafti isaa waan diigameef namoonni 22 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Qoshaa kuufamee ture kanaan mana jireenyaa naannicha jiran hedduun waan awwaalamaniif, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii kanaa caalaatti dabaluu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa bakka sana dhaqqabuun hojii barbaachaafi baraarsa isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: Photos: Ukraine celebrates National Flag Day
english: Ukraine recently celebrated National Flag Day, a holiday established in 2004 to honor the country's sovereignty. During ceremonies held in Kyiv, citizens and President Zelenskyy held a moment of silence to pay tribute to those who have lost their lives in the ongoing conflict with Russia. The event focused on fostering national unity and patriotism as the country continues its defense.
amharic: ዩክሬን የአገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ለማክበር በ2004 የተመሰረተውን የብሔራዊ ሰንደቅ ዓላማ ቀን አክብራለች። በኪየቭ በተካሄደው ስነ-ስርዓት ላይ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ እና ሌሎች ተሳታፊዎች በሩሲያ ጋር በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ህይወታቸውን ላጡ ሰዎች የአንድ ደቂቃ የህሊና ጸሎት አድርገዋል። ዝግጅቱ አገሪቱ መከላከሏን በቀጠለችበት በዚህ ወቅት የብሔራዊ አንድነት እና የሀገር ፍቅር ስሜትን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Yukireen guyyaa alaabaa biyyoolessaa kan bara 2004 hundaa'e, kan kabajamuufi hirmannaa biyyoolessaa ibsu ayyaaneffatteetti. Ayyaana kanaan walqabatee magaalaa guddoo Kiyiv keessatti sirna gaggeeffame irratti, Pirezidaanti Zelenskii fi lammiileen biyyattii waraana Ruusiyaa waliin jiru keessatti lubbuun isaanii darbeef daqiiqaa tokkoof kabajaa taa'aniiru. Ayyaanni kun waraana keessatti tokkummaa biyyoolessaa fi jaalala biyyaa jabeessuuf kan gargaaru ture.

title: Trump arrives at high-speed IndyCar race through Washington's streets
english: President Donald Trump attended the inaugural Freedom 250 IndyCar race held on the streets of Washington D.C. to celebrate the nation's 250th anniversary. The event features professional drivers racing at high speeds past iconic landmarks like the Washington Monument and the Capitol building. To facilitate the race, the city implemented major security measures, road closures, and a temporary flight restriction for a military flyover.

title: French President Macron to host Saudi Crown Prince MBS in Paris for talks
english: French President Emmanuel Macron is hosting Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in Paris for a two-day state visit to strengthen bilateral ties. The leaders plan to discuss critical issues including regional security, energy infrastructure, and ongoing conflicts in the Middle East. Additionally, the visit will feature a business forum and the signing of several cooperation agreements covering sectors like health and transport.

oromo: Pireezidaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakroon, abbaa taayitaa biyya Sa'udii kan ta'an Muraad Mohaammad biin Salmaan gamoo paalaasii Paariisitti guyyaa lamaaf simatanii mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen nageenya naannichaa, adeemsa dhiyeessii anniisaa, akkasumas walitti bu'iinsa gara garaa kanneen Baha Giddugaleessaa keessatti mul'atan irratti mari'atu jedhamee eegama. title: Can Nigeria cash in on Iran war?
english: Ongoing conflict involving Iran has strained global gas supplies, providing Nigeria with a strategic opportunity to boost its production and increase exports to Europe. Government officials are currently pushing to accelerate major gas projects and attract foreign investment to strengthen the country's role in the international energy market. Despite these international ambitions, the government is also working to address high domestic gas costs and encourage local households to switch away from traditional fuels like firewood.

title: Canada, US and tit-for-tat tariffs: How will they impact their economies?
english: A trade conflict has escalated between the US and Canada after negotiations failed, leading both nations to impose retaliatory tariffs on each other's goods. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney initiated these measures after rejecting US demands that he felt threatened Canadian sovereignty and cultural interests. Economists warn that this trade war will negatively affect both countries by increasing operational costs for businesses and raising prices for everyday consumers.

title: Gaza families search for children missing after years of war
english: Families in Gaza are desperately searching for children who went missing during the ongoing conflict. They are struggling to find information because official records have been destroyed and the region is heavily fragmented. Consequently, these families are calling on international organizations like the ICRC to help them locate their lost loved ones.

title: Iran government signals fuel price hike on eve of new US sanctions
english: The Iranian government is preparing citizens for a potential fuel price hike as it struggles to manage a weakening economy amid new US sanctions and war. Officials argue that current heavy fuel subsidies are financially unsustainable given the country's shrinking GDP and the plummeting value of the rial. Because similar price increases have triggered widespread protests in the past, authorities are approaching the decision with extreme caution.

Mootummaan gatii boba'aa gadi aanaa ta'e kana gargaaruu dadhabuun isaa fi gatiin maallaqa biyyattii (Riyal) gadi bu'uu isaa hordofee jijjiiramoota kana gochuun dirqama ta'uu ibseera. title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘has not become Venezuela’ despite war and sanctions
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian claims that his country has remained resilient despite facing intense economic, military, and security pressures. He rejected comparisons to Venezuela, asserting that Iran continues to stand firm. These remarks emphasize the government's stance on overcoming ongoing international sanctions and conflicts.

title: France links rise in drownings to heatwaves
english: France is reporting a significant 14% increase in drowning deaths this summer compared to last year, with over 300 fatalities recorded since mid-June. Government officials attribute this rise to extreme heatwaves that are driving people to swim in dangerous, unsupervised locations like canals or rivers. Authorities are now urging the public to be cautious, noting that the physical shock of entering cold water on a hot day can be fatal, especially for elderly individuals.

title: PM Tarique Rahman’s trip stalled: What it means for Bangladesh-India ties
english: The planned diplomatic visit of Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to India has been delayed due to ongoing tensions regarding the presence of ousted leader Sheikh Hasina in India. title: Nordic nations ‘have lost confidence in Infantino’, demand FIFA reforms
english: Six Nordic football associations have officially declared they no longer trust FIFA President Gianni Infantino and are calling for his resignation. They are demanding an independent investigation into his controversial plan to sell stakes in tournaments to private investors. Furthermore, the group is pushing for a major overhaul of FIFA’s leadership structure to ensure better transparency and accountability.

title: The Suez Crisis stopped the British Empire. Will Hormuz defeat the US?
english: A recent podcast episode explores historical parallels between the 1956 Suez Crisis and current tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. It examines how Egypt's decision to take control of the Suez Canal challenged imperial powers and permanently altered the global economy. The program questions whether similar dynamics regarding oil shipping and control over vital waterways could lead to significant geopolitical conflicts for the United States today.
